items.name: Casa Keiki
items.essence: Step from your door into the courtyard, and from the courtyard into the pool.
items.story: Casa Keiki sits on the garden level, where the courtyard is your front yard and the pool is a few barefoot steps away. Mornings here start slow — coffee outside, a swim before the day warms up, the surf two minutes down the street when you are ready for it.
items.bestFor: Best for couples who want the pool a step from bed.

items.name: Casa Mia
items.essence: Two bedrooms, a full kitchen, and a poolside patio — our home for families and friends.
items.story: Casa Mia is the biggest home in the house: two bedrooms, a living room, a full kitchen for long breakfasts, and a patio that opens straight onto the courtyard and pool. Built for families, friends traveling together, and anyone who wants room to spread out without leaving the oasis.
items.bestFor: Best for families & friends — full kitchen, living room, poolside patio.

items.name: Casa Peach
items.essence: A top-floor one-bedroom with its own covered terrace lounge.
items.story: Casa Peach is a full one-bedroom home on the top floor — open living and dining, a kitchen of your own, and a king bedroom with a desk for the work-and-surf crowd. The covered terrace is the heart of it: a hammock, a daybed piled with sugar-skull pillows, and the green of La Punta beyond. Slow mornings, long evenings.
items.bestFor: Best for work-and-surf stays — desk, kitchen, covered terrace.

items.name: Casa Yada
items.essence: A king bed, a private patio, and the courtyard a flight of stairs away.
items.story: Casa Yada is the easy middle of the house — second floor, king bed, a private patio for two. Close enough to the courtyard to feel the life of the place, far enough to disappear when you want to. The casa our returning guests ask for by name.
items.bestFor: Best for couples — king bed and a private patio.

items.name: Casa Linda
items.essence: Our spacious second-floor home for families and small groups.
items.story: Casa Linda takes the second floor with space to spare — two bedrooms and room for a small crew. Groups of friends, families with kids who fall asleep mid-sentence after a day in the water: this is your home. The courtyard and pool are one flight down.
items.bestFor: Best for families & small groups — two bedrooms, one floor up.

items.name: Casa Bel
items.essence: The top-floor home — full kitchen, living room, and a big private terrace.
items.story: Casa Bel is the top-floor home: a full casa with its own kitchen, a living room, and a wide private terrace strung with a hammock. Cook a long breakfast, work in the afternoon shade, watch the light go soft over La Punta. Room to properly settle in, with the surf two minutes down the street.
items.bestFor: Best for longer stays — full kitchen and a big private terrace.
